title: Close the loop
story: A battery and a lamp are wired up, but there is a gap in the top wire and the lamp is dark. Fill the gap so the lamp lights. In the lab the lamp is drawn as a resistor box, because a glowing lamp behaves like one (Phase 03 explains why). One of the pieces is a strip of plastic, drawn as a resistor so huge that almost nothing gets through it.

goals.label: current flows through the lamp, so it lights
the lamp gets the battery's whole push

hints: Follow the path with your finger: out of the battery's plus, through the gap, through the lamp, and back to the minus.
A gap stays a gap whether it is empty or filled with plastic: plastic is an insulator.
Only a conductor, like a piece of metal wire, closes the loop.
